statement: The record shows invoice 88412 was already paid in full on 3 September (PAY-2291), despite its conflicting “unpaid, due” status, so avoiding a likely duplicate payment has the greatest value.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the "unpaid, due" status conflicts with the record's own payment history showing it "was already paid in full on 3 September (PAY-2291)," making payment a "likely duplicate payment."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
